notes: A brand-new gamified onboarding: animated in-app scenes for every step, a quest tracker with XP as you set up, and a confetti finish. The whole app is smoother too - lighter glass blur and panel paint containment keep opens, drags and animations at full refresh rate. Also fixed: long voice prompts can no longer accidentally close working agents - close commands must be short and deliberate, and the voice model is now vetoed against your actual words before it can close anything.
